name: rough-cut-studio-suite
description: Root npm workspace manifest for the suite's one Node/Tauri app (harmonizer). CardEater was dropped from the migration (frozen/archived per its own CLAUDE.md, fully superseded by apps/suite-wrapper's in-process Python port -- see migration-plan.md §7 Phase 2), so there's no longer a second Tauri app to share config with; packages/config was folded back into apps/harmonizer directly rather than kept as an unjustified single-consumer package. The 6 Python apps are managed separately via the root uv workspace (pyproject.toml), not npm.
